title: Complex Hyperbolic Immersions of Cheng--Yau Metrics on Thullen Domains
summary: We classify the homotheties of the complete Cheng--Yau Kähler--Einstein metrics on the two-dimensional Thullen domains $M(μ)$, $μ>0$, that admit Kähler immersions into $\mathbb{CH}^{\infty}$. With $\Ric(g_{\mathrm{CY}})=-3g_{\mathrm{CY}}$, an immersion of $c\,g_{\mathrm{CY}}$ exists exactly when $0 1$ is characterized by an explicit equation, and its endpoint is included. Every admissible metric has a proper global Kähler embedding. The same parameter interval classifies immersibility into flat and projective Hilbert space, where every positive homothety admits a proper global embedding.…
